definition: John Florian Sowa (born 1940) is an American computer scientist, an expert in artificial intelligence and computer design, and the inventor of conceptual graphs.
details: John Florian Sowa (born 1940) is an American computer scientist, an expert in artificial intelligence and computer design, and the inventor of conceptual graphs.

explainer.lead: John F. Sowa is an Artificial intelligence researcher (born 1940). His work spans artificial intelligence, computer science and knowledge representation and reasoning.

contributions.name: Currently Sowa is working with Kyndi Inc., also founded by Majumdar.

timeline.what: Sowa spent most of his professional career at IBM, starting in 1962 at IBM's applied mathematics group.
After early retirement at IBM, Sowa in 2001 cofounded VivoMind Intelligence, Inc. with Arun K. Majumdar.
Receives the Knowledge Graph Conference Lifetime Achievement Award

affiliations: Harvard School of Engineering and Applied Sciences
